caption: The drawing features two depictions of a clown figure interacting with a large blue ball on a decorative round base. The central and largest depiction shows a clown wearing a red outfit with yellow buttons, a yellow ruffled collar, white gloves, brown shoes, and a red-and-white cap. The clown, whose face is painted in traditional clown makeup with red lips and a white face, is sitting on top of a large, shiny blue ball that has a yellow stripe around its circumference and an ornate red and yellow design on its side. This blue ball is placed on an ornately decorated metallic base with swirled patterns and four short legs. In the upper left corner, a smaller version of the scene appears, showing the same clown costume and blue ball, but the clown is balancing upside down on his hands atop the ball with his feet in the air; this smaller ball also rests on a round, decorated base. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional details or objects.
title: Toy Bank
